objective: Measure the frozen delay-v2 model on a later historical month without refitting, selection or threshold tuning.
source_scope: Historical US reporting-carrier records; not UAE airline operations
cohort: Completed, non-diverted flights with finite observed arrival delay and valid scheduled-flight fields
inference: Frozen registered model and preprocessing; no fit, partial_fit, calibration or threshold search
threshold: Exact numeric threshold from the frozen registered report
baseline: Constant training delay prevalence from the frozen registered report; never June prevalence

research_comparison.authority: Research comparison inherited from v2; not stakeholder or operational acceptance

uncertainty_plan.method: Resample complete flight-date clusters with replacement
uncertainty_plan.limitations: Only one month of clusters; no independence, population-transfer or significance claim

cohort_diagnostics.policy: Report predefined groups and exclusions; do not select a model or threshold from cohort results

data_admission: Register exact archive identity and source after this freeze; validate month, schema, identities and exclusions before evaluation. Preserve the original bytes privately.
attempt_policy: A future evaluator must create an exclusive attempt receipt before opening candidate rows, retain failures and refuse repeated evaluation. This plan registrar does not implement that evaluator or global single-use enforcement.
limitations: A later model period is not proof that no person or experiment previously inspected the month
Historical published schedules lack point-in-time snapshots
No forecast-of-cancellation, actual-flight confirmation, new model training or UAE transfer qualification
Data admission, inference, metric computation and bootstrap execution remain separate unfinished steps
